privacy.a3: Summary: ezBrowser does not track you.
privacy.a10: Cookies·site data — stored per-site just like a regular browser, and can be deleted from the lock icon menu or Settings.
privacy.a12: Only when you use the feature
privacy.a18: Text being typed in the address bar
privacy.a21: Search query (same as a regular browser)
privacy.a24: Text of the page being translated
privacy.a26: Approximate location (IP-based) or manually entered coordinates
privacy.a32: Current version check request (no personal info)
privacy.a34: The site itself / Google favicon service
privacy.a35: Domain of the site to display
privacy.a36: Other than this, there is no transmission to any analytics server or ad network operated by the developer. The third-party services above follow their own privacy policies.
privacy.a38: ezBrowser blocks ads and trackers by default (EasyList·EasyPrivacy·Korean KR filters). This blocks third-party scripts trying to track you, actually protecting your privacy.
privacy.a40: Browsing history·cookies·sessions in an incognito window are kept only in memory and deleted when the window closes.
privacy.a43: This policy may be updated as the product changes, and updates will be reflected on this page.

ai-profile.a4: ⚠ OS encryption isn't available in this environment, so info is stored in plain text. Avoid entering sensitive info (cards).

passwords.a2: OS-level encryption via safeStorage (Windows DPAPI · macOS Keychain · Linux libsecret)
passwords.a3: With accounts registered here in advance, the agent can get through login screens on its own. Passwords are stored only via OS encryption (safeStorage) and are never passed to the AI model or page scripts.
passwords.a14: Generated using the browser's built-in cryptographic randomness (Web Crypto) — never sent to a server.
passwords.a16: Only https sites can be registered.
passwords.a21: When on, the agent will type in this account and even click the login button on this site's login screen. The password is never sent to the AI model. Off by default — saving alone doesn't turn it on.
passwords.a25: Sites with save prompts turned off
passwords.a26: Sites where you chose "Not on this site". Turning it off here will prompt to save again on your next visit.
passwords.t9: Enter the site address, username, and password.
passwords.d5: Import accounts from this CSV file? Existing entries with the same site·username will be overwritten by the CSV values.
